scaleshelter.desc: Full local Overcoat blocks powder moves and sandstorm/hail damage. The first successful directly selected Quiver Dance per switch-in grants one ward: opposing damaging attacks deal 20% less HP damage until the end of the first such attack to damage HP, including all its hits. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage and zero HP damage preserve it. Called moves do not grant it; wards cannot stack.
scaleshelter.shortDesc: Overcoat; first selected Quiver Dance each entry grants a 20% whole-attack HP ward.

roughscale.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 max HP. Full local Tough Claws gives contact moves 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, after the first resisted opposing attack to damage HP finishes all its hits, raises Defense by 1 if the holder survives and remains active. Normal boost prevention applies. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage and zero HP damage do not activate it.
roughscale.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first resisted opposing HP attack each entry grants +1 Defense after the move.

baitedbloom.desc: Full local Gluttony makes pinch Berries activate at half HP and Leftovers heal 1/8 max HP each turn. Full local Regenerator restores 1/3 base max HP when switching out. Sticky Hold is supplied separately by base Victreebel's species passive. No first-Berry stat reward.
baitedbloom.shortDesc: Gluttony and Regenerator: early pinch Berries, stronger Leftovers; heals 1/3 on switching.

slipstream.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Once per switch-in, its first Flying-type attack to damage a foe sets Tailwind on its side for 3 turns. Existing Tailwind is extended to at least 3 turns, never shortened. Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus; shared accuracy entry rewards apply once.
slipstream.shortDesc: Airborne; immune to Ground attacks unless grounded — first landed Flying attack each switch-in sets 3-turn Tailwind.
